# Parse the real CSV data
csv_lines = sales_csv.strip().split("\n")
csv_header = [h.strip() for h in csv_lines[0].split(",")]
all_deals = []
for row_line in csv_lines[1:]:
    row_vals = [v.strip() for v in row_line.split(",")]
    all_deals.append(dict(zip(csv_header, row_vals)))

print(f"Columns: {csv_header}")
print(f"Total deals: {len(all_deals)}")

# Filter James Okafor deals
james_deals = [d for d in all_deals if d["rep_name"] == "James Okafor"]
print(f"James Okafor total deals: {len(james_deals)}")

# Target won deals
target_ids = {"D001", "D003", "D006"}
james_target_won = [d for d in james_deals if d["deal_id"] in target_ids and d["status"] == "won"]
print(f"James target won deals (D001, D003, D006): {len(james_target_won)}")
for d in james_target_won:
    print(f"  {d['deal_id']}: {d['product']} | ${float(d['amount']):,.0f} | {d['region']} | {d['close_date']}")

# James overall stats
james_won_all = [d for d in james_deals if d["status"] == "won"]
james_won_total = sum(float(d["amount"]) for d in james_won_all)
james_pipeline_total = sum(float(d["amount"]) for d in james_deals)
james_pending = [d for d in james_deals if d["status"] == "pending"]
james_lost = [d for d in james_deals if d["status"] == "lost"]

# Overall team stats
team_won = [d for d in all_deals if d["status"] == "won"]
team_won_total = sum(float(d["amount"]) for d in team_won)

print(f"\nJames won deals: {len(james_won_all)}, total won value: ${james_won_total:,.0f}")
print(f"James total pipeline: ${james_pipeline_total:,.0f}")
print(f"Team total won: ${team_won_total:,.0f}")
